rows.en:
You gave me chocolate, so I couldn't
just let it go! Go on, open it up.
Oh, this is...

Yeah, when I think of your hobbies,
Shirakawa, it's tea, so I went with
a teacup.
What do you think?
Are you sure I can really have this?

Of course!
I bought it for you, Shirakawa.

...Thank you... \p-kun.
I'll treasure it for the rest of my life...
(I'm glad Shirakawa seemed happy with it.)

Oh, Hilda-sensei!
This is my return gift for Valentine's Day!
Hm? Ah, it's you?

Yes, I thought it might do as thanks
for the other day...
This is... a cake...?

Yes, it's from a popular shop
in the Shibuya Area!

Are you an idiot?
Don't hand me a lump of sugar and fat
like this!
Ah... that's... I'm sorry...
Honestly, what were you thinking...

Oh, then I'll, um, come back another time.
I'm sorry...

No, wait.
I'll gladly accept the gratitude behind it,
so I'll take that too. Cake now and then is fine.
rows.notes: Hilda. Tama ni wa keeki mo ii darou.

rows.en:
But don't you repeat the same mistake
next time!
(Hilda-sensei really is kind underneath...)

Here, Hoshimura.
It's White Day, so this is my return gift...

Ooh, now that you mention it, today's White Day!
Well then, I'll accept it without
further ado, I will!
I hope you like it...
Wh-why, could this be...
rows.notes: x2: Hoshimura (wrench) and Pinon (ribbon) on seeing the gift; works for both.

rows.en:
Yeah, you love tinkering with machines,
right, Hoshimura? So I figured maybe
a top-grade wrench, but...
rows.notes: Trails off: Hoshimura answers '\p...' (outside this slice) and the player panics.

rows.en:
Huh, you don't want it?
I'm really sorr...
rows.notes: Cut off as in the Japanese (gome...).

rows.en:
No, no, I'm tickled pink! You truly mean it?!
Givin' me something this fine!

Of course.
I bought it for you, Hoshimura.
Th-thank you kindly... \p.

(Yeah, Hoshimura seemed happy too.
I'm really glad I gave her a return gift.)

(It's White Day today, but I wonder
if Yamashiro-sensei remembered?)

\p, good timing.
There's something I want to give you.

This is a return gift for Valentine's.
Take it.

Thank you, Yamashiro-sensei.
...Wait, what is this?

An assortment of homemade candy and cookies.
As a White Day return gift, nothing
could be more fitting.
Wow... Thank you so much, Yamashiro-sensei.
I'm glad to see you like it.

Oh, Akimizu.
This is my return gift for Valentine's Day...
Huh? Oh, th-thank you!
I'm not sure if you'll like it, but...

Wow, it's so cute~!!
Thank you~!

I remembered you collect stuffed animals
and cute stuff... It's a plushie of
a creature called a 'Gyararashi'...
rows.notes: Gyararashi (in quotes in the Japanese) is not in the glossary; romanized. Akimizu says it goes with Mylene of Fire Bomber.

rows.en:
Uh-huh, it's really cute!
It's the one that's always with Mylene-san
from Fire Bomber, right?

Oh, is that so?
You really know your stuff, Akimizu.

Yes, I've actually wanted one for ages...
so I'm really happy!
Glad to hear it~

Even if it was by chance, you picked
the perfect thing! Let's keep getting
along from now on, okay?

(I can't believe Akimizu was that happy...
I'm glad I gave it to her!)

Claire-senpai,
it's White Day, so here's my return gift.

You went to the trouble of bringing it?
Thank you.
Here, please go ahead and open it.
rows.notes: x2: the player to Claire and to Klan (both senpai).

rows.en: Oh my, this is...!

Yes, I heard aromatherapy was your hobby,
Senpai, so I got you an aroma candle.
Are you sure I can really have this?

Of course.
I bought it for you, Senpai.

Th-thank you...
I'll use it with care.
(I'm glad Claire-senpai seemed happy with it.)

Here, Pinon-chan.
It's White Day, so this is my return gift...

Hm? Now that you mention it, today is
White Day... Well then, I'll take it
without holding back.
I hope you like it...

Yeah, collecting ribbons is your hobby,
right, Pinon-chan? So I bought a ribbon
I thought would look cute on you.

Whoaaa~ It's so cute~
Is it okay? Can I really have this?

Of course.
I'm glad you're that happy about it.
Ah!

N-no, I was only overdoing it
to make YOU happy, got it?!

Well, I suppose I can at least
say thank you...
Th-thanks... \p.

(Pinon-chan seemed happy, so I'm
really glad I gave her a return gift.)

(It's White Day today, but I wonder
if Saotome-kun remembered?)

Hey, \p.
Here, this is for the other day...
Hm, thanks for Valentine's, you mean?
Mm, well, something like that.

I see. Thank you, Saotome-kun!
This is, um...

Yeah, it's a 'tenugui,'
the same kind I use all the time.
rows.notes: Alto. Tenugui (thin cotton hand towel) kept, since the player repeats the unfamiliar word next row.

rows.en: 'Tenugui'?

Yeah. Unlike a towel, it dries fast and
feels nice on your skin, so I figured
it'd be good for a woman.

Just what I'd expect from a genius
of female roles! You really know women!
rows.notes: Tensai onnagata = kabuki actor of female roles (as slice 334: 'played female roles').

rows.en:
If you're gonna tease me,
give that back!

Ah, sorry, sorry!
I'll gratefully accept it!

(Saotome-kun's surprisingly considerate.
That alone makes me kind of happy.)

missing_glossary: Gyararashi (c23251): plush creature associated with Mylene of Fire Bomber; romanized
